title: Friedliche Tiere und Battle Mobs
goal: Birds, fish, cows, herbivore dinosaurs, ghosts and the EntityCannonFodder family (docs/catalog/README.md section 4.7). Read the hand-off notes docs/port/W01.md up to the previous wave first. Apply DECISIONS R20 (NoStepTrigger where the original canTriggerWalking returns false; Mth.floor for coordinate casts) and the W04 XP lesson (1.7.10 EntityAnimal.getExperiencePoints returns 1 + rand.nextInt(3) regardless of experienceValue - check each entity's base class before porting XP). ENTITY PORTER CONTRACT for every entity in this wave: (1) the entity class with the original class name, attributes from the manifest/MobStats at runtime, SynchedEntityData for every DataWatcher index, NBT save/load, AI goals in original priority order, custom movement/physics in customServerAiStep in original order, drops as Java in dropCustomDeathLoot (R10), sounds via ModSounds, XP, despawn rules, spawn placement predicate ported from getCanSpawnHere (registration via registry_entries; natural biome spawns are W12); (2) EntityType registration with the manifest id, MobCategory per R9/R18, hitbox from the manifest size, tracking range per R9 - via registry_entries; (3) attribute creation via registry_entries; (4) the model class <Name>Model in client/model/ baking the generated <Name>Geometry (never edit geometry) with setupAnim ported from the original render()/setRotationAngles() per R8, translucent/GL passes per docs/research/06-models-design.md; (5) the renderer with scale() from preRenderCallback, texture variants via getTextureLocation, shadow size from the original; renderer + layer registration via registry_entries; (6) the spawn egg for the entity (manifest kind spawn_egg, match its name) using the W01 generic spawn egg class, registered via registry_entries, with its item model on the original egg texture. Classes implement the W01 MyUtils marker interfaces where the original MyUtils predicates name them. Back-edges from docs/catalog/README.md 4.14 into this wave: grep the tree for 'TODO W06' and fill them if they are in files you own; otherwise report them in registry_entries for the integrator.

workers.task: Port the small flyers and critters listed, with their renderers and models. Flight without navigation as the original motion code (catalogue 5.3).
owns: client/model/ files for CockateilModel, CliffRacerModel, CricketModel, DragonflyModel, CoinModel, TshirtModel

gametests: every W06 entity type spawns in the arena and ticks 100 ticks without exception (R17) and has its manifest max health and hitbox; RedCow family tame/breed with their original items; battle mob hats split teams (EntityCannonFodder); an Ostrich accepts a rider and rises on the rider's fly-up state; each spawn egg of this wave spawns its entity; drops of one sample per worker match the behaviour chapter; all earlier tests still pass.
